nisha: Heads-up: finalizing release notes tomorrow. Need polish on changelog lines, migration link, and known-issues item.
anya: I'm on changelog bullets. Keep each <80 chars.
sam: I'll finish the Python + Node snippet parity today, plus small error handling note.
rachel: I found two broken anchors in migration guide; opening redirect PR.
docs-bot: link-checker: 2 broken links -> /docs/api/embeddings-legacy and /docs/dedicated/old-batching. Ticket #902.
anya: Use phrase 'superseded' for public copy for the embeddings endpoint.
nisha: For known-issues, add repro for quantized streaming truncation and a temporary workaround: pin max_sequence=1024. Include curl example.
sam: Snippets updated. Python uses RedwoodClient(), Node uses RedwoodClientV2(). Added streaming example and note about token accounting.
rachel: Redirects PR #483 opened. Requesting review from @anya.
docs-bot: deploy-preview started.
docs-bot: deploy-preview: success -> https://deploy-preview-170.docs.redwood.ai
anya: Merge plan: PRs merged by EOD, run docs build, then post release digest in #announcements. Thanks everyone :tada:
